report.title: DSPy Framework Syntax Error Fixes - Batch 2
report.summary: Fixed systematic import block insertion issues in 7 DSPy framework files. The adaptive_mdap import blocks were incorrectly inserted between method definitions and their bodies, causing syntax errors.

files_fixed.root_cause: Adaptive MDAP import block inserted between 'display' function definition and its body (print statement)
files_fixed.fix_applied: Moved import block to module level (after 'import tqdm') and restored 'print(obj)' inside the display function

files_fixed.root_cause: Adaptive MDAP import block inserted inside EM() function, between docstring and function body
files_fixed.fix_applied: Moved import block to module level (at top of file) and restored return statement inside EM() function

files_fixed.root_cause: Adaptive MDAP import block inserted inside majority() function, between docstring and function body
files_fixed.fix_applied: Moved import block to module level (after imports) and restored assertion code inside majority() function

files_fixed.root_cause: Adaptive MDAP import block inserted inside __init__() method, between docstring and method body (self.module = module)
files_fixed.fix_applied: Moved import block to module level (at top of file) and restored self.* assignments inside __init__() method

files_fixed.root_cause: Adaptive MDAP import block inserted inside __init__() method, between docstring and method body (super().__init__())
files_fixed.fix_applied: Moved import block to module level (at top of file) and restored super().__init__() and other code inside __init__() method

files_fixed.root_cause: Adaptive MDAP import block inserted inside __init__() method, between docstring and method body (self.k = k)
files_fixed.fix_applied: Moved import block to module level (after 'import numpy') and restored self.* assignments inside __init__() method

files_fixed.root_cause: Adaptive MDAP import block inserted inside __init__() method, between docstring and method body (super().__init__())
files_fixed.fix_applied: Moved import block to module level (after 'from litellm import') and restored super().__init__() and other code inside __init__() method

pattern_analysis.description: All 7 files had the same systematic issue: an adaptive_mdap integration import block was incorrectly inserted INSIDE method/class definitions instead of at module level
pattern_analysis.common_import_block:
# **ACTUAL INTEGRATION**: Adaptive MDAP for <Module>
try:
    from adaptive_mdap import TaskComplexityClassifier, AdaptiveMDAPAllocator
    from adaptive_mdap.core.types import SubProblem
    ADAPTIVE_MDAP_AVAILABLE = True
except ImportError:
    ADAPTIVE_MDAP_AVAILABLE = False
    TaskComplexityClassifier = None
    AdaptiveMDAPAllocator = None
    SubProblem = None
pattern_analysis.resolution_strategy: Moved all adaptive_mdap import blocks to module level (top of file, after other imports) and restored the original code that was displaced
